integrity: Exact subset enumeration, symbolic composition, finite structural closure and rational-root checks replayed from standalone source. No external certification or independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Idealized functional ecological corridor connectivity under binary edge operability; valid only for two-terminal series-parallel multigraphs with identical distance and minimum-cut constraints. No claim of demographic persistence, equal vertex count, arbitrary graphs, or empirical movement calibration. Full-text priority comparison with some historical reliability papers remains unavailable.
title: A sharp eight-corridor split between independent and fixed-budget ecological connectivity rankings
